question: Who among the following won the first 'MTArt Agency x India Art Fair Artist Prize’ during the 15th India Art Fair held in February 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sajid Wajid Sheikh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sajid Wajid Sheikh** won the first '**MTArt Agency x India Art Fair Artist Prize**' during the **15th India Art Fair** held in **February 2024**.
 
• The **India Art Fair** is a prestigious event that showcases a wide range of artworks from contemporary artists.
 
• The **MTArt Agency** is known for supporting and promoting talented artists globally.
 
• This prize recognizes the significant contributions of emerging artists in the field of contemporary art.
 
• **Sajid Wajid Sheikh's** work is celebrated for its unique style and cultural relevance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Devika Rani**__

 __
 
• **Devika Rani** was an early Indian film actress who is remembered as the first lady of Indian cinema.
 
• She was the recipient of the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**, India's highest award in cinema, for her lifetime contribution to Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Birendranath Sircar**__
 __
 
• **Birendranath Sircar** was a pioneering Indian film producer and founder of New Theatres Calcutta.
 
• He was also awarded the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** for his contributions to Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Asha Parekh**__
 
 
• **Asha Parekh** is a renowned Indian film actress, director, and producer who was active in the Hindi film industry during the 1960s and 1970s.
 
• She has received numerous awards for her performances, including the **Padma Shri**, one of India's highest civilian honors.
